statement: The system shall allow each team to manage its own budget independently.
The system shall allow the IFA to monitor team budgets and conduct audits.
The system shall allow the IFA to define budget policies and regulations.
The system shall alert the IFA of budget policy violations.
The system shall allow IFA administrators to view financial transactions of teams.
The system shall generate financial reports from team data on an annual basis.
The system shall allow referees to input game events in real time using a mobile application.
The system shall make game-related data publicly accessible to unregistered guests.
The system shall allow export of game-related data for external use by journalists or press.
The system shall allow team managers and administration to view their team's internal data and perform offline analysis.
The system shall restrict teams to viewing and entering only their own budget data.
The system shall allow the IFA to view consolidated monetary information across all teams.
The system shall allow the IFA to request adjustments or details from teams but not perform direct financial operations.
The system shall support automated scheduling of matches based on definable policies.
The system shall allow definition of scheduling policies such as home and away games for each team pair.
The system shall support automated assignment of referees to games based on defined policies.
The system shall prevent the same referee from officiating multiple games of the same teams.
The system shall allow referees to input availability preferences such as vacation periods.
The system shall allow manual rescheduling of games in exceptional circumstances such as weather disruptions.
The system shall allow IFA representatives to manually override automatic scheduling results.
The system shall require justification for any manual override of scheduling.
The system shall require a second IFA representative to confirm any manual scheduling change.
The system shall allow definition of minimum gap days between games as part of scheduling policy.
The system shall allow fans to register for push notifications about specific games.
The system shall allow fans to register for push notifications about specific players.
The system shall allow teams to have public pages that fans can follow.
The system shall allow players to have public profiles that fans can follow.
The system shall allow fans to receive real-time notifications of in-game events such as player substitutions.
The system shall provide a unified backend with different interfaces for different stakeholders.
The system shall provide a web-based interface for teams and IFA administrators.
The system shall provide a mobile application for referees and fans.
The system shall allow fans to access official real-time game updates without relying on external news portals.
The system shall send automated reminders for policy compliance, such as annual report submissions.
The system shall allow users to set custom alerts, such as reminders before a game starts.
The system shall respond within one to two seconds for fans, IFA administrators, and team administrators under normal conditions.
The system shall prioritize referee inputs during games to ensure real-time responsiveness.
The system shall support up to 50,000 simultaneous users.
The system shall support localization including language, currency, and time zone adaptation.
The system shall comply with local data regulations in different countries.
The system shall encrypt budget data to prevent unauthorized leakage.
The system shall allow players to update their social network page within the system.
The system shall require user registration and identification for all stakeholders except guests viewing public data.
The system shall support a team registration process initiated by team managers or owners and approved by the IFA.
The system shall maintain archives of past seasons' scheduling and game data.
The system shall allow the IFA to define leagues and seasons.
The system shall allow the IFA to register and appoint referees.
The system shall allow teams to register player details.
The system shall allow the IFA to audit player registration without direct input into the process.
